# Skill documentation rules

Read [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) first.

- The root `SKILL.md` is the shipped protocol doc and has an 8,192-byte hard cap. Put new detail in `references/` and link to it.
- Document only skills that exist in C#: never invent a skill name or parameter. Run `/skillcheck` (`.claude/commands/skillcheck.md`) after adding, renaming or removing a skill — it also syncs the skill counts across `AGENTS.md`, both READMEs and the root `SKILL.md`.
- The 29 advisory modules under `unity-skills~/skills/` are documentation only: no REST skill, no C# stub, ever.
- Each module keeps its `SKILL.md` plus sibling files and one `reference/` level; document actual parameter names and return shapes.
- Skill counts and category tables are generated by `/skillcheck`; never hand-edit a count.
- `.md` files have no BOM.
